Can I add an item to an order I already placed?

Orders can’t be edited to add items once they’ve been placed. The best path is usually:

If the order is still within the cancellation window, I can check whether it can be canceled so you can place a new order with the extra item.
If it’s already processing, go ahead and place a separate order for the additional item.

Send me the email used at checkout, and I’ll check the order for you right away. ✨

What happens if it already shipped, can it still be changed?

Once an order has already shipped, it can’t be changed or canceled.

That means:

items can’t be added or removed
the shipping address usually can’t be updated through us
the shipping method can’t be changed

The best next step is to let it arrive, then return it if needed. If your concern is the shipping address, send me the email used at checkout and I’ll check whether there’s anything else I can confirm for you right away. ✨

If your order is canceled, you’ll receive a cancellation confirmation email
